title: thinkinboutyou.com: carve your names into this website
note: Are you in love? in a thin outlined script, then a typewriter paragraph: carve your names into this website to celebrate (pretend you are carving your names in a tree). Visitors left initials (A&M, L&M…) set in a bold pixel face with a tiny FOREVER, scattered among hearts cut from soft, blurred photos that drift over the page. A boxed counter: accepting 333 crushes total. 333 crushes recorded. Worth reusing: boxed counters as plain bordered type, and heart-cropped photos as decoration that still carries real pictures.
